description: Export a public system's tokens in one format: globals-css, colors-ts, spacing-ts, typography-ts, tailwind-theme or brand-manifest. Calls the legacy /api/systems/export endpoint, not a v1 path - the export route has no v1 equivalent yet.

format.description: One of globals-css, colors-ts, spacing-ts, typography-ts, tailwind-theme, brand-manifest (default globals-css)

name.description: System name, public slug or alias (e.g. "launchwp")

name: get_system_tokens
